shared_elements: procession/frieze of figures moving in one direction
low-relief carving with linear interior detail (beards, hair, drapery rendered as parallel lines)
ground-line register with a decorative band below the scene
justification: Both show low-relief friezes of bearded male figures in strict profile moving in a single direction alongside a large profile quadruped, with the same conventions for rendering beards, hair and garments as fine parallel incised lines and with a patterned/foliate ground register beneath. The subject matter differs sharply, however: A is a violent action scene with a chariot, wheel, harnessed horse and armed soldiers over a marsh ground-line, whereas B is a calm procession of men leading a humped pack animal and carrying vessels between ornamental rosette borders.
